R_RESET: active-high areset with z=0 while reset is asserted
active-low areset with z=0 while reset is asserted
active level unspecified; reset value of z unspecified or previous
active-low areset: asserted=0, released=1, with z=0 while asserted.
On reset assertion, state returns to START but z retains its previous value (here 1) instead of forcing z=0.
R_CONVERT: pre-posedge Moore output, delaying the first converted bit by one observation cycle
